{{nihongo|'''Isagu Shrine'''|伊佐具神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Settsu Province]].

'''Isagu Shrine''' (いさぐじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} located in Kamisakabe, {{ill|Amagasaki|Q213318|qid=Q213318}}, {{ill|Hyōgo Prefecture|Q130290|qid=Q130290}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and under the {{ill|Q712534|lt=former shrine ranking system}} it was classified as a {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.

=== Enshrined deities ===
* Ikisashiniri-hiko no Mikoto and two other unidentified deities
* Associated shrines: Miyahachimangū, Konpira Shrine, Atago Shrine, Tenman-gū<ref>Information board at the shrine</ref>

=== History ===
The ''{{ill|Settsu Meisho Zue|ja|摂津名所図会|qid=Q11498549}}'' states: “Located in Kamisakabe Village. Listed in the ''{{ill|Engishiki|ar|إنجيشيكي (كتاب ياباني)|de|Engishiki|es|Engishiki|fr|Engishiki|he|אנגישיקי|id|Engishiki|it|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|ko|엔기시키|min|Engishiki|mr|इंगिशिकी|nl|Engishiki|pt|Engishiki|ru|Энгисики|simple|Engishiki|tr|Engishiki|uk|Енґісікі|zh|延喜式|qid=Q1342448}}''. Now called {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Inari Myōjin}}. Together with Morimura, it serves as the {{ill|Ubusunagami|Q1392097|qid=Q1392097}}.”

Among the seven {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha}} shrines of {{ill|Kawabe District, Hyōgo|ceb|Kawanabe-gun|es|Distrito de Kawabe|fr|District de Kawabe|id|Distrik Kawabe, Hyōgo|it|Distretto di Kawabe|ja|川辺郡|ko|가와베군|pl|Powiat Kawabe|ru|Кавабе (уезд, Хёго)|zh|川邊郡|qid=Q1042053}}, this is the only shrine with the distinguished tradition of having {{ill|Hoe (tool)|Q131154|qid=Q131154}} and {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=quivers}} dedicated to it by the Imperial Court.
Furthermore, in “{{ill|Engishiki|ar|إنجيشيكي (كتاب ياباني)|de|Engishiki|es|Engishiki|fr|Engishiki|he|אנגישיקי|id|Engishiki|it|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|ko|엔기시키|min|Engishiki|mr|इंगिशिकी|nl|Engishiki|pt|Engishiki|ru|Энгисики|simple|Engishiki|tr|Engishiki|uk|Енґісікі|zh|延喜式|qid=Q1342448}} {{ill|Genbaryō|Q11572314|qid=Q11572314}} Volume 21,” it is recorded that this shrine was one of twelve shrines selected from {{ill|Yamato Province|Q907495|qid=Q907495|lt=Yamato}}, {{ill|Settsu In June of {{ill|Genkō (1331–1334)|de|Genkō|fa|گنکو (۳۴-۱۳۳۱)|fr|Ère Genkō (deuxième)|ia|Genko|ja|元弘|ko|겐코 (1331년)|ru|Гэнко|simple|Genkō (era)|sr|Генко (друга ера)|sv|Genkō|tr|Genkō (ikinci)|zh|元弘|qid=Q1194556}} 3 (1333), it is said that {{ill|Akamatsu Norimura|Q2828933|qid=Q2828933|lt=Akamatsu Enshin}} established a {{ill|Position|Q11658173|qid=Q11658173}} near this shrine and prayed here for victory in battle.

=== Precincts ===
* Isagu Shrine name-inscribed stone marker – A shrine marker identified as a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} by {{ill|Namikawa Seisho|Q6563872|qid=Q6563872}}. The front bears the inscription “Isagu-sha.” It is designated a Tangible Cultural Property of Amagasaki City.
* {{ill|Gorintō|Q304906|qid=Q304906}} – A stone pagoda dating to around the {{ill|Gen'ō|Q1193925|qid=Q1193925}} era (1319–1321), said to be the grave of Akamatsu Enshin.
* Hakuryū Inari Shrine – Uses the hall of the former temple Jōtoku-ji of the Shingon sect, retaining traces of syncretism between Shinto and Buddhism.
* Hachiman Shrine
